notes: SM120(Pro5000, no NVLink) dense_hybrid_gdn 27B fp8. No --context-length (falls back to native 262144). No EP (dense). PP=1. mamba-radix-cache-strategy left at SGLang default no_buffer (TODO axis). fcfs (independent requests, no lpm). 4-candidate budget: TP ladder {8,4,2} on flashinfer + attention A/B at full-box; mem-fraction-static pinned 0.88 for comparability. Deferred to downstream staged sweep: mem-fraction, chunked-prefill, max-running-requests, kv-cache-dtype, schedule-conservativeness, MTP/EAGLE, and TP1/TP8-triton.

reasons: Full-box baseline: uses all 8 GPUs; natural production reference for a dense 27B and lowest-risk starting point (baseline-first, §6 A).
attention=flashinfer: SM120 short-list is [flashinfer, triton] only (fa3 hard-fails, trtllm_mha prefill raises). auto-select falls back to flashinfer on SM120, so this is the canonical anchor (§1).
mem-fraction-static=0.88: safe middle from default pool [0.80,0.84,0.88,0.92]; hybrid-GDN KV is tiny so OOM risk is low; pinned for cross-candidate comparability (§3).
No EP (dense), PP=1, no --context-length (§0), fcfs (independent qa-chat requests, §4).

Attention A/B vs c001 at the same TP/mem: attention backend is the one axis with zero official+team data and must be measured; candidate count is cheap because SM120 leaves only flashinfer/triton (§1, §6 B).
triton is the SM120 fallback backend; on some kernels it beats flashinfer for decode, so worth a head-to-head at the full-box baseline.
Same pins as c001 (dense→no EP, PP=1, no --context-length, fcfs).

TP lever, step down from 8: no NVLink on Pro5000 means all-reduce runs over PCIe, so halving TP partners (8→4) often lifts throughput; fp8 weight 6.8 GB/card fits comfortably and hybrid-GDN KV headroom is ample (§2).
17408/128=136 → block-quant TP divisibility satisfied at TP4 (§2 block-quant gate).
Uses 4 of 8 GPUs — per-server vs per-GPU efficiency trade-off is left for the executor to weigh against c001.
Low-TP end of the ladder: minimal all-reduce (2-way) — most favorable for a NVLink-less box if TP8/TP4 turn out comms-bound (§2 ordering hint).
fp8 weight 13.5 GB/card fits easily; tiny hybrid-GDN KV means large concurrency headroom even at TP2; loose SLA (tpot 80ms) is easy for a 27B fp8.
Uses only 2 of 8 GPUs (6 idle) — a per-replica reference; flag downstream that full-box utilization would need multiple replicas or DP.
TP1 (single-GPU) and TP8+triton were dropped to fit the 4-candidate budget; add them if the ladder shows a clear TP trend.
